title: sicydium tamnifolium
intro: Sicydium tamnifolium, commonly known as the West Indian pepper, is a plant species in the family Rutaceae. It is a shrub native to tropical regions of the Americas and the Caribbean. The West Indian pepper has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and providing antioxidant properties. The plant's bioactive constituents include limonoids, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties.
